title: No hardcoding: the marked ledger's constants computed from their constraints, at 0.874835173
description: Proves the all-moduli Dirichlet boundary 874835173/1000000000. Starting from PR 50's source tree with the affine detector count of PR 52 and PR 56, the hand-picked constants of the marked ledger are replaced by the quantities they stand for, computed in Lean. The bin split of the LOW/HIGH ledger is the root of a strictly increasing residual (the price channel and the capped live channel of the marked saving both tight in the top cell), located by interval arithmetic and proved exact; the slope is the moving slope (430q^2 - 399q + 135)/(q(24q^2 - 34q + 35)) that makes the price bound of the HIGH reserve equal in every cell; the intercept is the largest one the price channel allows; the caps of the marked count, its bin top, its root cutoff and the amplifier cap and floor are the values at which their constraints hold with equality; the row length is the optimum of the top-row certificate; the slacks with a gate are the formulas of that gate; the savings of the row certificates are fixed fractions of the claim margin. All enclosures are computed by a bracket command at elaboration time and checked by the kernel. A Lean theorem shows that no other bin split and intercept admitted by the marked ledger gives a smaller class bound. 33 hand-picked constants of the starting tree are eliminated. The valuation price and the per-cell supplied width follow PR 62. Inherited attribution is preserved in the modules.
